root_cause: Validated OpenAI JSON candidate contained a blogtext outside the hard 900-1500-word range; generation had no controlled attempt to revise an underlength or overlength draft.
correction: Request a 1150-1300-word draft. When only word-count validation fails, retry up to two times with the preceding generated draft, aggregate public learning signals, and explicit target length; preserve strict validation and fail closed on exhaustion.
privacy: Only whitelisted numeric marketing aggregates and public blog identifiers reach OpenAI. Revisions may include the previously OpenAI-generated draft; no downloaded raw Brain JSON or user/customer records.
guardrails: No automated padding or fabricated filler
Do not mutate published blogs or Notion approval gates
